title: Generic declarations
requirements: 03.01. Every required generic class or protocol is generic over the correct type parameter.
03.02. Type parameters are declared in the correct scope.
03.03. The file uses one coherent generic declaration style.
03.04. Modern PEP 695 syntax is not redundantly combined with module-level `TypeVar` declarations or `Generic` inheritance.
03.05. Generic relationships preserve the payload type consistently across entries, predicates, snapshots, and the journal.
